pages.text: $(italic)Born of decay, the Witherborn wields the Wither itself as a weapon.$()$(br2)$(bold)Origin Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Touch of Decay$() — $(item)Melee attacks apply Wither to targets$(). Bosses normally immune to Wither receive True Wither instead.$(br2)$(bold)Wither Blood$() — $(item)Immune to the Wither effect$(). The decay flows through you, not against you.$(br2)$(bold)Relentless Strikes$() — $(item)+15% attack speed$(). Frantic, decaying energy fuels rapid attacks.

pages.title: The Cost of Decay
pages.text: $(bold)Fading Strength$() — $(warn)Lose up to 50% damage as hunger decreases$(). The emptier your stomach, the weaker your strikes.$(br2)$(bold)Withered Appetite$() — $(warn)Food provides only 25% nourishment$(). Your decaying body barely processes sustenance.$(br2)$(bold)Wasting Away$() — $(warn)+50% hunger drain$(). Your body consumes itself.$(br2)$(italic)Keep eating or wither away. The Witherborn is a feast-or-famine origin — devastating when well-fed, helpless when starving.$()
